images.caption: The Adventures of Tintin mural painting by Hergé. Location: Rue de l'Etuve 37, Brussels. Surface: ± 36 m². Realisation: Oreopoulos G. and Vandegeerde D. Year: July 2005. Comment: The scene belongs to the album The Calculus Affair. The Adventures of Tintin (Les Aventures de Tintin) is a series of classic comic books created by the Belgian artist Georges Rémi (1907–1983), who wrote under the pen name of Hergé.
